s.note: up again watching the camera footage
s.how: Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread. Fill 4 sandwiches with 200g grated cheddar and a thin spread of Dijon and toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side. Cut into strips.
Brush a large lavash with oil. Stencil letters and numbers on with smoked paprika and bake at 180C until crisp. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt to dip. Don't ask it anything.

m.note: eating in front of the footage
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes and top with 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rewatch the tape.

w.how: Warm 300ml cream and 200ml milk, pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Whisk 4 yolks with 60g sugar and combine. Pour into 4 small cups and bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes. Chill until set.

d.note: staying up to check the tape
d.how: Make 4 shots of espresso (about 120ml) and cool for 5 minutes. Shake half the batch at a time: 60ml espresso, 80ml vodka, 40ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup over plenty of ice for 20 seconds until frothy. Strain into 2 chilled coupes and repeat. Float 3 coffee beans on each.
